<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/portal_report"}
#docs
Customer portal sessions signed in during [`start`, `end`] (civil days in the business timezone), and the actions they took, read from the events each session emitted. `arrival` is how the link was made: an email link carries the type of the email that sent it (`email` when none is recorded), `email_code` a sign-in with an email code, `api` every other link (the dashboard uses the API). Payments are the payments a portal session made, by the day they happened; `recovered_from_failed_emails_minor` is the part paid in visits that arrived from a failed-payment email (`payment_failed`, `payment_authentication_required`, `dunning_action_required`). Cancellations and the save rate come from the portal cancel flow, as the `cancellation_saves` report counts them, and are narrowed by `plan` only (not by `arrived_from`, `country` or `device`). `tracking` holds first-party visit figures (no cookies; GPC and DNT honoured): sections viewed, countries, devices, browsers and invoice PDF downloads; `tracking.since` is the first tracked view. `country` and `device` narrow the other figures to sessions with a matching tracked visit. With `compare=true`, `previous` holds the same figures for the window just before. Money is integer minor units in `currency`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | `string` | **yes** | First civil day of the window, in the business timezone |
| `end` | `string` | **yes** | Last civil day of the window, inclusive. At most 366 days. |
| `compare` | `string` | no | Also return the previous window of the same length |
| `currency` | `string` | no | Report in this currency only. Default: every currency, converted into the business currency |
| `arrived_from` | `string` | no | Only visits that arrived this way: an arrival key from `options.arrivals` |
| `plan` | `string` | no | Only customers with a subscription on this plan product |
| `country` | `string` | no | Only sessions with a tracked visit from this country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, from the visitor's request) |
| `device` | `string` | no | Only sessions with a tracked visit from this device category |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `portal_report`. One of `portal_report`. |
| `business` | `string` | The business id. |
| `start` | `string` | The first day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `end` | `string` | The last day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `previous_start` | `string` | The first day of the previous window. |
| `previous_end` | `string` | The last day of the previous window. |
| `timezone` | `string` | The business time zone. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency of the money figures. |
| `missing_rates` | `array of string` | Currencies with no exchange rate, left out of the money figures. |
| `options` | `object` | Filter values seen in the window. |
| `totals` | `object` | The window's figures. |
| `previous` | `object` | The same figures for the previous window; null unless `compare=true`. |
| `live` | `object` | Right now, whatever the window. |
| `days` | `array of object` | The window's days, in order. |
| `series` | `object` | Per-day figures, one per day in `days`. |
| `funnel` | `array of object` | Made, opened, took an action. |
| `arrivals` | `array of object` | By arrival. |
| `actions` | `array of object` | Completed actions. |
| `payments` | `object` | Portal payments by method, and saved versus new methods. |
| `payment_methods` | `object` | Methods added, deleted and made primary, and delete reasons. |
| `plan_changes` | `object` | Plan changes, pauses and cancellations made in the portal. |
| `retention` | `object` | The cancel flow: started, saw an offer, took one, saved; with reasons. |
| `recent` | `array of object` | The newest ten visits in the window. |
| `tracking` | `object` | First-party visit tracking over the window (visits whose page ran in a browser). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The portal report |
| `400` | Invalid window or unknown plan |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/portal_report?start=2026-03-14&end=2026-04-14" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
